lcc_original: 二人的眼睛就開朗了，纔知道自己是赤身裸體，便縫了無花果樹的葉子，爲自己作圍裙。
notes: LCC drops UNV's 他們 (implicit subject pronoun); WH08147 (שְׁנֵיהֶם, both-of-them) attaches to 二人 alone.
LCC 開朗 (became bright/enlightened) is a rephrasing of UNV 明亮 but maps to the same WH06491 (פָּקַח, to open).
UNV 拿 has no SN and is absent from LCC; LCC 縫了 directly renders WH08609 (תָּפַר, to sew) with aspect particle 了 treated as one unit, following the UNV pattern of 明亮了<SN>.
LCC 裸體 (bare body) substitutes UNV 露體 but both render WH05903 (עֵירֹם, naked).
{<WAH03588>} retained as implicit — no explicit כִּי in LCC either.
LCC comma after 葉子 preserved exactly; 便 and 了 left unannotated (no Hebrew equivalents).
